main_failure_modes: Confirmation bias is used for two distinct hidden mechanisms, producing strict label errors despite mechanism and location matches.
The affect-heuristic finding explains faster action from relief, while hidden wishful thinking concerns desired source veracity inflating confidence.
The single cross-source finding was assigned to selective attention; belief bias was not separately detected.
main_strengths: Framing, planning fallacy, and authority deference are identified with full mechanisms, valid evidence, and equivalent or exact labels.
All six findings use valid interview quotations, and the occurrence summary reconciles with the finding list.
At the recommended threshold, there are no segment-level false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong segment detection and a substantial taxonomy gap: two mechanisms are recognized but fail strict label scoring, one is partially captured, and one is not separately identified.
